sections.title: Section 197 - Limitation of time for Assessment (1) Subject to the provisions of sub-sections (2) and (3), after the expiry of the period as follows-
sections.content_text: Section 197 - Limitation of time for Assessment (1) Subject to the provisions of sub-sections (2) and (3), after the expiry of the period as follows- (a) within 3 (three) years after the completion of the assessment of tax made under section-235 in the relevant tax year in which the said income first became assessable; or levied if the tax had been assessed in due course shall apply; and (b) in case the return is not filed within the time prescribed under section 171;within 1 (one) year from the end of the tax year in which the said income first became assessable. (c) in the case of assessment of tax except in the case mentioned in clauses (a) and (b) within 6 (six) months after the end of the tax year in which the said income first became assessable. (2) If a notice is issued under sub-section (1) of section 212, tax will be assessed within 2 (two years after the end of the year in which the notice is issued under section 212. (3) Notwithstanding anything contained in this section, the time for taking any action shall be limited, in consequence of the observation or direction given in an order under section 213, 285, 289, 292, 294 or 295, assessment of tax, as the case may be, or in the case of a firm, an assessment of tax made for a partner of the firm as a result of an assessment of tax made for the firm, or an agreement made based on consensus of an agreement reached under section 304, within 30 (thirty) days the said order or agreement is notified and such revised order shall be intimated to the taxpayer within next 30 (thirty) days. (4) In the case where the tax assessment order is set aside by any authority, the tax assessment shall be made within 60 (sixty) days from the date on which the said order is notified. (5) Where, by any order under section 213, 285, 289, 292, 294 or 295, any income of a taxpayer is excluded from the total income for a tax year, the assessment of tax on that income for any other tax year shall, for the purposes of this section, any decision under that order or shall be deemed to have been made in consequence of, or for the purpose of giving effect to, the direction. (6) Where, by any order under section 213, 285, 289, 292, 294 or 295, any income has been excluded from the total income of any person and has been assessed as the income of another person, for the purposes of this section, such income of the latter person shall be deemed to have been made as a result of the decision or direction of the said order or for the purpose of giving effect to the direction. (7) If the Deputy Commissioner of Taxes fails to give any order or instruction mentioned within the time limit in sub-section (3), such failure of the Deputy Commissioner of Taxes shall be considered as misconduct.
